query: WITH known AS ( SELECT w.owner_id AS id FROM workspaces w JOIN workspace_shares s ON s.workspace_id = w.id WHERE s.user_id = $1 AND w.state <> 'deleted' UNION SELECT s.user_id FROM workspace_shares s JOIN workspaces w ON w.id = s.workspace_id WHERE w.owner_id = $1 AND w.state <> 'deleted' UNION SELECT theirs.user_id FROM channel_members mine JOIN channel_members theirs ON theirs.channel_id = mine.channel_id WHERE mine.user_id = $1 AND theirs.user_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT u.id, u.email::text AS "email!", ($5::uuid IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_members m WHERE m.channel_id = $5 AND m.user_id = u.id)) AS "member!" FROM users u WHERE u.disabled_at IS NULL AND u.id <> $1 AND ( ($4 AND u.email = $2::text::citext) OR (($3 OR u.id IN (SELECT id FROM known)) AND ($2 = '' OR u.email::text ILIKE $6 || '%'))) ORDER BY u.email LIMIT $7
